def transform(grid):
    g=[r[:] for r in grid]; H,W=len(g),len(g[0])
    for i,row in enumerate(g):
        vals=set(row)
        if len(vals)==2:
            c=max(vals)  # stripe color
            idxs=[j for j,x in enumerate(row) if x==c]
            if len(idxs)<W and (idxs[0]==0 or idxs[-1]==W-1):
                for j in range(W):
                    if g[i][j]!=c: g[i][j]=1
    return g
